mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice ( no, state, name, subject, content, filename, filesize, regdate, hit, filecount ) VALUES ( notice_no_seq.nextval, #{state}, #{name}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{filename}, #{filesize}, SYSDATE, 0, #{filecount} )
mapper.select: SELECT no,state,name,subject,TO_CHAR(regdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') as dbday,hit FROM notice ORDER BY no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
